# Document the clearer report layout

Once the report has been made clearer, bring the documentation into line with what the emitter
now produces:

- update the report-rendering rows of `TESTING.md` so they describe the new layout,
- update `CLAUDE.md`'s description of `artifacts/report.golden.txt` if the artifact's shape changed.

This item exists to keep the documentation from drifting away from the artifact, so it can only be
done once the new layout is settled.
